create.name: Debra Busemeyer Baker
create.bio:
Debra Busemeyer Baker is a psychic medium, Reiki Master and crystal worker who lives and works around Kansas City. Her intuitive life began in December 1988, when she found herself doing automatic writing for her father, and in the decades since she has given readings that pass on messages from people who have died and from spirit guides and angels, alongside spiritual counsel she describes as channelled from Source. She has also served as a Oneness Blessing giver.

As a teacher she concentrates on intuition and on Reiki. Her 2014 book, Amazing Intuition, is a practical workbook for learning to notice and trust inner guidance day to day, told through stories from her own readings. She teaches all three Reiki levels one to one, so that each class can be shaped around the student, and with every attunement she records a message she receives from the student's Reiki guides. Each week she posts a new guided meditation to her YouTube channel, usually around a quarter of an hour of relaxation and imagery on themes such as hope, wonder or meeting the higher self. She also offers private sessions that combine crystals, Reiki and intuitive guidance.

books.title: Amazing Intuition: Expanding Your Most Important Resource
books.author: Debra Busemeyer Baker
books.description: A workbook-style guide to recognising and using intuition in everyday life, with exercises and pages to fill in as you go. Debra mixes the method with light-hearted stories from her years of giving readings.

courses.title: Reiki I Training
courses.description: A one-to-one first-degree class of about two hours: an introduction to energy work and to Reiki itself, the attunement, and a Reiki session from Debra. Each student also receives a recording of a message Debra channels from one of their Reiki guides.

courses.title: Reiki II Training
courses.description: A one-to-one second-degree class of about three hours that reviews the basics and then teaches the Reiki symbols and how to work with them. It includes the attunement, a Reiki session and a recorded channelled message.

courses.title: Reiki Master / Teacher Training
courses.description: The final level, taught individually, for people who want to teach Reiki themselves. Alongside the attunement and session, much of the time goes on the knowledge and skills needed to guide students, with a full manual to take away.

courses.title: Intuitive Sessions with Debra
courses.description: Private readings in which Debra relays messages from loved ones who have died, from spirit guides and angels, or offers spiritual counsel; questions are welcome throughout. Sessions can include a second person sitting in.

flags: Base: her site and author bio say only that she lives in 'the Kansas City area' (reviews quote clients in Overland Park and Olathe, Kansas). The state is not published; 'Kansas City, Missouri' was recorded as the metro's main city. A human should confirm or change it to the Kansas side.

Health rule, borderline: every YouTube title begins 'Healing Meditation' (no condition named); the videos are relaxation and imagery. Two titles about the body ('Grateful for our bodies', 'my body') were left out. Her Energy Work page speaks of 'miraculous results' and Reiki in hospitals; kept out of the bio and items.

Book ISBN-13 9781626469112 was read from an AbeBooks cover image on her author page (a bookseller, not her own site); confirmed on Open Library https://openlibrary.org/isbn/9781626469112.json (Booklocker.com, 2014, author Debra Busemeyer Baker). No cover URL used.
YouTube channel avatar is a spiral logo, so both photos are from her own site (the same outdoor portrait session, autumn 2025).
Video titles carry the session date (e.g. '4 14 26'); they are weekly recorded meditations, evergreen in content, kept as titled.
The site also sells crystals and stones; not listed.
left_out: Chakra Clearing Meditation and Messages from Dead People (site shop items): their pages did not render any description, date or price without scripts.
Session options of 30, 90 and 120 minutes and the two-person hour: kept to one sessions item.
Crystal bracelets, palm stones and selenite bowls: products, not teaching.
Energy Work (crystals and Reiki) sessions: covered by the sessions item; its page uses healing-results language.
YouTube 'Healing Meditation 11 3 26 Grateful for our bodies' and '4 28 26 my body': body-focused titles, left out under the strict health rule.
